### GameplayGearPreset.characterTypes

Key: `characterTypes`

Key: `name`

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |

### GameplayGearPreset.spawnWeight

Key: `spawnWeight`

Path: `[]`.`spawnWeight`

SpawnWeight is the preset's relative selection weight. It must be at least 1;
higher values make the preset more likely to be selected.

| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Constraints | `minimum=1` |
